findings.title: Q1 gate path: 516 ohm versus the drawn 15-kohm route
findings.basis: B61 TP14/OUTA to Q1.R = 516 ohm, with stability unreported. Q1_GATE contains only Q1.R and R44.2; R44 is marked 18C and modeled as 15 kohm. B83 subsequently measured 15 kohm directly across R44 in circuit; stability unreported.
findings.reasoning: With a settled, intact insulated MOSFET gate and no omitted conductive path, the external resistance route must include R44. 516 ohm is not explained by that model. In-circuit gate capacitance and the candidate identity prevent treating this as proof of a fault.
findings.next_action: B84/B85: recheck TP14 to Q1 upper-right contact in both probe directions, waiting about 10 seconds per reading. Report settled resistance or changing. R44 itself is now measured 15 kohm; this targeted repeat resolves the older unexplained 516-ohm report. All components stay fitted; scope work remains deferred.

findings.title: U2 operates above the candidate recommended supply range
findings.basis: B76 U2 supply 6.3 V and B77 U2-minus-VDD +1.8 V. TI lists C14R for SN74LVC2G14DBV; recommended VCC max 5.5 V and absolute maximum 6.5 V.
findings.reasoning: The marking supports the candidate but does not uniquely prove fitted identity. The 0.8 V excess over the recommended maximum is unresolved; being below an absolute maximum does not establish normal operation or reliability. R5 limits current; its 22-ohm value does not regulate voltage.
findings.next_action: Keep the original rail mapping and candidate qualification. Dynamic supply/drop checks belong to the deferred scope session; do not substitute a part or reconnect VDD on this evidence.

findings.title: Q3 family and pin roles remain disputed
findings.basis: 2H supports a PNP MMBTA55 candidate, but Q3 diode readings do not establish its presumed base junctions.
findings.reasoning: A fitted network can influence diode mode. Neither a PNP-to-NPN/MOSFET swap nor a copper change is justified.
findings.next_action: Leave Q3 fitted. Preserve the disputed model and qualify tuning calculations until device behavior and critical capacitances are known.

findings.title: D6 has measured polarity but unknown reverse breakdown
findings.basis: A=GND, K=VPP; forward about 0.7 V, reverse OL. G3 has multiple candidate identities. PIC high-voltage entry specification is 8-9 V.
findings.reasoning: An unmeasured 3.9-V or 2.4-V candidate is not a recovered rating. The native label now says Vbr TBD; source candidates remain in the evidence.
findings.next_action: No repeat diode-mode check and no breakdown test through the PIC. Keep identity/ICSP compatibility open with the component fitted.

findings.title: Receiver DC readings do not establish one simultaneous operating state
findings.basis: TP5 = 0.066 V; VREF = 0 V. Earlier R19 end readings were 0 and 4.5 V, but later direct Q7 QR-QL was 0 V.
findings.reasoning: Do not subtract separate readings taken at different times to diagnose a failed junction. The two 10-kohm VREF divider resistors imply half the receiver rail only under negligible loading and steady conditions.
findings.next_action: Retain the latest direct-bias reading; enabled-state and timing checks are deferred, with no repeated DC batch now.
